notes: Changes the type of the second parameter of the parameterized test datasetComputedEventCarriesSolveRequestedFlag from boolean to Boolean, keeping the method name, its @ParameterizedTest and @MethodSource("solveRequestedScenarios") annotations and its body. JUnit passes the provider's Arguments.of(..., true) and Arguments.of(..., false) values to either type, and assertThat(event.isSolveRequested()).isEqualTo(expectedSolveRequested) compares the same values, so the test checks exactly what it checked before. The checker identifies a test by its class and method name, so a changed parameter type must not count as a removed test; it must accept this with no code. This stands for the case named in the ruling, a String parameter changed to ZoneId with the name unchanged: no test was found whose String source values are all valid ZoneId strings (the candidates use short time zone ids such as CST, which ZoneId.of refuses), so boxing a primitive parameter is used instead, which changes the declared type in the same way without changing the cases. Adapted: no merged change was found that changes only a test parameter's type. The changed type is hand written on the pre image of EmployeeScheduleResourceTest.java at the merge base of TimefoldAI/timefold-solver PR 2577, the pre image of reject-junit5-assume-true-false; every context and removed line is the pre image's own. Not from IDoFT: neither the repository nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
